exam_scheme.note: The Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) is a national-level examination administered jointly by the Indian Institute of Science (IISc) Bangalore and seven Indian Institutes of Technology (IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Guwahati, IIT Kanpur, IIT Kharagpur, IIT Madras, and IIT Roorkee) on behalf of the National Coordination Board (NCB)-GATE, Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education (MoE). The examination tests comprehensive understanding of undergraduate subjects in Engineering, Technology, Architecture, Science, Commerce, and Arts. The 3-hour Computer Based Test (CBT) consists of 65 questions totaling 100 marks across 30 distinct test papers. Question types include Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ), Multiple Select Questions (MSQ), and Numerical Answer Type (NAT). Scores are valid for three years for admission to M.Tech/Ph.D. programmes and recruitment in major PSUs.
